hotel_name: Fabhotel Cabana - Hotel In Greater Kailash, New Delhi

positive_snippets: If only I could give location and service more stars. Such friendly and helpful staff members. And location could not be better than this. Highly recommended
negative_snippets: Good location. Rooms are okay. Don’t provide enough towels or toilet paper. Had some weird communication issues with the staff when doing an early check-in; they were reluctant to tell me the price of doing an early check-in in advance. At first it was 1500 rupees, then 1500-2300, then 2500 when I asked them to write the price down. Eventually they did honor the first price of 1500, but it was a poor experience.

It's a very well located old hotel. Staff is very nice and friendly. Standard room was neat and clean but very small but fine for a solo traveller. Amenities like TV and aircon were so old an dated like 15 years. Shower system needs to be replaced as well. Refrigerator was not cooling at all. Overall 3 star and needs improvement.

The AC was dripping water inside the room and the wash basin in the bathroom was a bit clogged and there was water leaking in the toilet. The prices are reasonable and so we shouldn’t expect 5 star quality services but the basic maintenance wasn’t done properly and I found that the water boiler provided in the room hasn’t been cleaned in a while and was very dirty. Breakfast was ok and service was also ok. The location is good and easily accessible in google maps and uber too.
